items.title: Malik Nabers: Quiet in Week 9 win
items.text:
Nabers caught five of eight targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Eagles.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Managing elbow issue following Week 9 action
items.text:
Coach Andy Reid acknowledged after Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets that Mahomes will likely be sore Monday after suffering an apparent elbow injury during the contest, Lindsey Thiry of ESPN reports.

items.title: Breece Hall: Gets 18 touches in return
items.text:
Hall (quadriceps) rushed 15 times for 61 yards and caught three of four targets for 26 yards in Sunday's 35-12 loss to the Chiefs.
